input_messages.content: Hi, I just placed an order with two watches, and I need to change the shipping address. Can you help with that?
I don’t remember the email I used, but my name is Noah Ito and my zip code is 98187.
I don’t have the order ID handy right now. But I just placed it, and it’s the one with two watches. Can you find it with my name and zip code?

Yes, that’s the one. Please use that address for the watches. Also, I need to change one of the watches—the silicone one—to a metal band instead. If there are color options, I’d like white.

Yes, go ahead and make those changes. Also, I have another order with an air purifier and a speaker. I want to change the purifier to the large size with night mode, but still with a HEPA filter. Can you help with that too?
I don’t have the order ID for that one either, but it’s the only order I have with both an air purifier and a speaker. Can you look it up by my name and zip code?
Yes, please go ahead and update both orders as you described.
Great, thanks for handling all of that. That’s all I needed. ###STOP###
